notice.title: The routine

story.nl: Na de lunch werkte ik verder.
story.english: After lunch I continued working.
story.telugu: మధ్యాహ్న భోజనం తర్వాత నేను పని కొనసాగించేవాడిని.

notice.title: The past background
notice.subtitle: Compare a past habit with one completed conversational fact.
notice.formulaNote: The regular past singular of werken is werkte.
notice.valuableContrast: Ik werkte vroeger thuis sets the background or describes a habit. Ik heb gisteren gewerkt reports a completed fact.

journeys.title: What had already happened
journeys.subtitle: VVT · earlier past
journeys.learningGoal: Place an earlier completed event before another past event.

story.nl: Ik had al gewerkt voordat de vergadering begon.
story.english: I had already worked before the meeting began.
story.telugu: సమావేశం ప్రారంభమయ్యే ముందు నేను ఇప్పటికే పని చేశాను.

story.nl: Voordat ik naar kantoor ging, had ik rustig gewerkt.
story.english: Before I went to the office, I had worked quietly.
story.telugu: నేను కార్యాలయానికి వెళ్లే ముందు ప్రశాంతంగా పని చేశాను.

story.nl: Toen de bel ging, had ik al twee uur gewerkt.
story.english: When the bell rang, I had already worked for two hours.
story.telugu: గంట మోగినప్పుడు నేను ఇప్పటికే రెండు గంటలు పని చేశాను.

story.nl: Ik had thuis gewerkt voordat het kantoor openging.
story.english: I had worked at home before the office opened.
story.telugu: కార్యాలయం తెరవకముందు నేను ఇంటి వద్ద పని చేశాను.

story.nl: Voordat de deadline kwam, had ik aan het project gewerkt.
story.english: Before the deadline arrived, I had worked on the project.
story.telugu: గడువు రాకముందు నేను ప్రాజెక్ట్‌పై పని చేశాను.

notice.title: The earlier past
notice.subtitle: Notice how VVT places one completed event before another past event.

comparison.label: VVT
comparison.sentence: Ik had al thuis gewerkt voordat de vergadering begon.

comparison.label: VTT
comparison.meaning: completed fact from the present viewpoint

notice.formulaNote: VVT uses the past auxiliary had plus gewerkt to show an earlier completed event.
notice.valuableContrast: Ik had al thuis gewerkt voordat de vergadering begon places one completed action before another past event. Ik heb gisteren gewerkt reports a completed fact from the present viewpoint.

journeys.title: Plans and possibilities
journeys.subtitle: OTTT + OVTT · future and conditional
journeys.learningGoal: Distinguish an explicit future plan from a conditional possibility.

story.nl: Morgen zal ik thuis werken.
story.english: Tomorrow I will work at home.
story.telugu: రేపు నేను ఇంటి వద్ద పని చేస్తాను.

story.nl: Als het regent, zou ik thuis werken.
story.english: If it rains, I would work at home.
story.telugu: వర్షం పడితే, నేను ఇంటి వద్ద పని చేస్తాను.

story.nl: Na de lunch zal ik aan het project werken.
story.english: After lunch I will work on the project.
story.telugu: మధ్యాహ్న భోజనం తర్వాత నేను ప్రాజెక్ట్‌పై పని చేస్తాను.

story.nl: Volgende week zal ik met een nieuwe planning werken.
story.english: Next week I will work with a new schedule.
story.telugu: వచ్చే వారం నేను కొత్త షెడ్యూల్‌తో పని చేస్తాను.

story.nl: Bij slecht weer zou ik in een rustige ruimte werken.
story.english: In bad weather I would work in a quiet room.
story.telugu: చెడు వాతావరణంలో నేను ప్రశాంతమైన గదిలో పని చేస్తాను.

notice.title: Plans and possibilities
notice.subtitle: Compare a future plan with a conditional possibility.

comparison.label: OVTT
comparison.sentence: Als het regent, zou ik thuis werken.

notice.formulaNote: Zal marks an explicit future; zou frames the action as conditional or hypothetical.
notice.valuableContrast: Morgen zal ik thuis werken makes the future explicit. Als het regent, zou ik thuis werken depends on a condition; everyday Dutch often uses OTT for a straightforward future plan.

journeys.title: Completed future and unreal past
journeys.subtitle: VTTT + VVTT · advanced completion
journeys.learningGoal: Recognise a completed result viewed from a future or hypothetical point.
journeys.storyTitle: Voor het einde van de dag

story.nl: Voor het einde van de dag zal ik acht uur gewerkt hebben.
story.english: By the end of the day, I will have worked for eight hours.
story.telugu: రోజు ముగిసే సమయానికి నేను ఎనిమిది గంటలు పని చేసి ఉంటాను.

story.nl: Als ik meer tijd had gehad, zou ik langer gewerkt hebben.
story.english: If I had had more time, I would have worked longer.
story.telugu: నాకు మరింత సమయం ఉండి ఉంటే, నేను ఎక్కువసేపు పని చేసి ఉండేవాడిని.

story.nl: Om vijf uur zal ik al acht uur gewerkt hebben.
story.english: At five o'clock, I will already have worked for eight hours.
story.telugu: ఐదు గంటలకు నేను ఇప్పటికే ఎనిమిది గంటలు పని చేసి ఉంటాను.

story.nl: Voor de deadline zal ik aan het project gewerkt hebben.
story.english: Before the deadline, I will have worked on the project.
story.telugu: గడువుకు ముందు నేను ప్రాజెక్ట్‌పై పని చేసి ఉంటాను.

story.nl: Als de planning anders was geweest, zou ik langer gewerkt hebben.
story.english: If the schedule had been different, I would have worked longer.
story.telugu: షెడ్యూల్ భిన్నంగా ఉండి ఉంటే, నేను ఎక్కువసేపు పని చేసి ఉండేవాడిని.

notice.title: Completion from another viewpoint
notice.subtitle: Notice how the same completed action can be viewed from the future or a hypothetical past.

comparison.label: VTTT
comparison.sentence: Voor het einde van de dag zal ik acht uur gewerkt hebben.

comparison.label: VVTT
comparison.sentence: Als ik meer tijd had gehad, zou ik langer gewerkt hebben.

comparison.label: VTT
comparison.sentence: Ik heb vandaag acht uur gewerkt.
comparison.meaning: completed fact from the present viewpoint

notice.formulaNote: The auxiliary pair zal hebben or zou hebben frames gewerkt as completed from another viewpoint.
notice.valuableContrast: VTTT looks forward to a completed result before a future point. VVTT imagines a completed result that did not happen; everyday Dutch often chooses a simpler construction instead.
